copy.title: App Toolkit: Everyday tools in one app
copy.headline: Everyday tools, one app
copy.description: App Toolkit for Android: Water Eject, Ruler and Protractor, Unit Converter, Tip and Bill Splitter, Decision Wheel and more, in one app.
copy.longDescription: One app. Many everyday moments. The App Toolkit name, then the water world: a tone pushes water out of a speaker; the last wave flattens into a ruler while the Surface Ruler measures 76.0 mm and the Protractor sweeps to 45 degrees; the reading becomes a conversion; the conversion folds into a receipt split two ways; a wheel lands on Music, and its confetti becomes the app's tools, which gather into App Toolkit.
copy.altText: App Toolkit's tool shapes gather round its icon; Water Eject pushes water out of a Pixel phone's speaker; a sound wave flattens into a ruler beside the Surface Ruler and Protractor phones; 76.0 mm becomes 7.6 cm; the unit cards fold into a receipt split in two; a decision wheel lands on Music and its confetti turns into the app's tools, which gather into the App Toolkit icon and the Get it on Google Play badge.
